entries.002eaf3b23817247: This business melts steel in electric arc furnaces using iron scrap as the main raw material, and manufactures and sells steel products such as H-beams and hot coils. There are no consolidated subsidiaries; the business is conducted by the company alone and constitutes a single steel segment. Production and sales are carried out at four domestic plants (Tahara, Okayama, Kyushu and Utsunomiya) and the head office, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥268,095 million.

entries.c7b65331a2b37292: As its basic management policy, the company states that through recycling of steel resources it will strive for energy and resource conservation and contribute to environmental protection. Its medium-term management strategy states that it will promote advanced use of iron scrap and pursue product diversification, improved productivity and quality, and thorough cost reduction. In addition, under its long-term environmental vision 'Tokyo Steel EcoVision 2050', it states that it will work to expand the supply of decarbonized, recycling-based electric furnace steel products.
entries.c81d19c21baef9ed: As Japan's largest electric furnace steelmaker, the company produces a wide range of steel products, from H-beams to hot coils, at its four domestic plants. In July 2024 it announced the low-CO2 steel brand 'Hobo Zero', and in November 2025 electric furnace steel was formally adopted in the automotive sector, which has extremely stringent quality requirements.
